items.condition: Final R/S ordering relies on a candidate without per-candidate one-imaginary-frequency and intended-mode/path-connectivity evidence.

A candidate used for the final scientific comparison has missing or inconsistent candidate ID, atom mapping, stereochemical outcome or charge/multiplicity. An explicitly failed extra candidate may omit unavailable successful-validation fields and earns no result credit.
Compared energies use different references, temperatures, standard states or unreported transformations.

The report claims success without the required validated R/S pathways or scientific coverage/stopping evidence, or claims an ordering from an unresolved candidate family that could reverse it. A valid success does not require bounded-failure blockers; an honest bounded failure does not claim unavailable results.
